title: 闲鱼自动发货即梦会员教程
text:
This video is going to keep you up for the next 48 hours.
Because after watching it,
you'll have no excuse
left to say, 'I don't know how to get started.'
Becoming a Dreamina Membership Agent.
You've probably never heard of it,
and your first reaction is probably, 'Is this another scam?'
But what's even more frustrating is that
you don't even get the chance to find out
if it's real or not.
Because every time you try to get started,
you get stuck on the very first step:
finding a supplier. You're trapped by the information gap.
Even asking AI gets you mostly unreliable recommendations.
But today, we're putting an end to all that. I'm
not just going to teach you
how to do it.
Instead, I'm going to walk you
through becoming a Dreamina Membership Agent,
and I guarantee you'll get the hang of everything
from sourcing to auto-delivery in no time.
For beginners, don't get greedy.
Closing your first sale
is way more important than dreaming about a hundred.
I don't need to tell you how popular Dreamina is
for making AI videos.
The first thing you need to figure out
as a Dreamina membership agent
is whether this whole thing is a scam.
No matter how awesome Dreamina's features are,
it has absolutely nothing to do with
whether you can make money from it.
We're not professional creators,
but we still want to make money with AI.
So, what we can do is sell low-cost memberships
to these very professionals.
The best part is, it's an official direct top-up,
and it's even cheaper than the official price.
This low-price supply network
is officially provided by the company
to its channel partners.
So, besides offering free trials to new users
on their own official platform,
they also give us channel partners
even lower prices for promotion.
So, we're going to leverage this information gap
to become Jī Mèng member agents.
Step one: The supply network
is just a small piece of the puzzle.
Next, I'll show you
how to set up your Jī Mèng agent business on Xianyu.
To make sales on Xianyu,
you need a title that gets you traffic,
pictures that catch the eye,
and a description that seals the deal.
Once you get that, let's talk about how to actually do it.
First, you need to set up a shop that can take payments.
Step one: Set up a Fish Shop.
Go to Xianyu and search for 'Fish Shop'.
Find the cheapest one you can—don't pay more than ten yuan.
After you've paid,
add the seller's customer service
and follow their instructions.
Your shop will be automatically activated within 48 hours.
Once it's set up, just list any random product.
You can find the main image from your competitors
or a Douyin livestream,
and use AI to generate the description.
This is just to set up the automatic delivery for now.
Step 2: Configure the shipping channel from your supply network.
Alright, head over to the low-cost supply network website.
Once you're logged in,
go to your personal center,
then to Account Management,
and from there, to Interface Management.
Click 'Reset' to get your interface key
and AppID, and copy them.
Alright, go to this website,
sign up, and log in. On the left, click on 'Supply Source,'
then 'Own Supply Source,' and add a supply source account.
For the account name, just type in whatever,
and select 'Standard' for the system.
Paste in the key and App ID you just copied.
For the interface gateway,
use this URL. For the product ID,
just type in anything for now, like 4257.
Then, click 'Test and Publish'.
Keep the price low,
and the inquiries will naturally flow.
Be straightforward, and you'll get orders fast and in bulk.
Step three: Set up the auto-fulfillment tool.
Open this website.
The first time you log in,
you'll need to purchase the auto-delivery service.
Choose the subscription-based plan.
Click on 'Post Product,'
and select the item you listed in the first step.
Go into the product settings, add the item,
and select the supply network you just set up.
Enter the real product ID.
Go to this website and search for the product,
like the 'Ji Meng Membership'.
Then, find the product ID on the product page and fill it in.
Keep refreshing your listings and adding new ones,
and your traffic will stay steady.
Step four: Daily updates and new listings.
Keep listing new items every single day.
For the main image of the Jimeng Membership,
you can post it through the backend
or the Xianyu mobile app.
Just find one from your competitors
or a livestream screenshot.
As for the copy,
you can generate it with AI
or just copy what your competitors are using.
Every day, you can boost your item's exposure
by editing the title, description,
or completing the 'polish' task.
Simply put, becoming a Xianyu Dream Agent Membership seller
is all about closing the loop on your profit chain:
sourcing products, setting up your shop,
listing them, and shipping them out.
You don't need to master every single detail.
Just follow these four simple steps:
First, open a 'Xianyu Pro Shop'
to get professional seller tools.
Second, connect to a supply network
and set up your 'ammunition' for automatic shipping.
Step three: Set up an auto-delivery tool
to free up your hands and get paid 24/7.
Step four: Update your listings daily,
use the 'refresh' feature,
and optimize them to keep getting exposure.
This method breaks down a complex side hustle
into a simple, executable process.
The key isn't watching tons of tutorials,
but actually completing one full transaction loop.
Making money on Xianyu isn't about luck;
it's about the right method and sticking with it.
If you run into any issues while you're actually doing this,
like not knowing how to reply to customer inquiries,
or struggling to write product listings that get traffic,
or you're stuck on all sorts of little details
with no one to ask,
That's why we've created the Xianyu AI Agent.
It's here to answer all your specific questions
about selling on Xianyu, 24/7.
From what to say to customers to the platform's rules,
it's got you covered.
Click or reply with the keyword 'Agent'
to start your free trial now,
and let AI be your personal side hustle assistant.

# 闲鱼自动发货即梦会员教程知识图谱

## 知识总览

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A1["信息差导致难以找到供应商"] --> B1["低价供应网络（官方直充）"]
    B1 --> C1["在闲鱼开设鱼店"]
    C1 --> D1["上架任意商品并使用AI生成描述"]
    D1 --> E1["配置供应网络的发货渠道"]
    E1 --> F1["设置自动发货工具"]
    F1 --> G1["每日上新与优化"]
    G1 --> H1["完成交易闭环：获利"]
    style A1 fill:#f9f,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px
    style H1 fill:#bbf,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px
```

## 成为梦会员代理的步骤流程

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    S1["获取低价供应网络信息"] --> S2["在闲鱼搜索并购买‘鱼店’（≤10元）"]
    S2 --> S3["激活店铺（48小时）并上架初始商品"]
    S3 --> S4["配置供应网络的接口Key/AppID"]
    S4 --> S5["在平台添加供应源账号并设置网关URL、产品ID"]
    S5 --> S6["测试并发布，保持低价吸引询单"]
    S6 --> S7["购买并设置自动发货工具（订阅制）"]
    S7 --> S8["关联已上架商品，填写真实产品ID"]
    S8 --> S9["每日更新商品、刷新曝光、优化文案"]
    S9 --> S10["完成订单，获取收益"]
```

## 供应网络接口配置细节

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["登录低价供应网络网站"] --> B["进入个人中心"]
    B --> C["打开账户管理"]
    C --> D["进入接口管理"]
    D --> E["点击‘重置’获取 Interface Key 与 AppID"]
    E --> F["复制Key和AppID"]
    F --> G["在闲鱼平台左侧‘供应源’页面"]
    G --> H["选择‘自有供应源’并添加账户"]
    H --> I["账户名随意，系统选‘标准’"]
    I --> J["粘贴Key和AppID"]
    J --> K["填写接口网关URL"]
    K --> L["产品ID先填任意数字（如4257）"]
    L --> M["点击‘测试并发布’"]
    M --> N["低价策略确保询单自然流入"]
```

## 每日上新与曝光提升

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["获取主图：竞争对手或直播截图"] --> B["生成或复制商品文案（AI或抄袭）"]
    B --> C["在后台或闲鱼APP发布新商品"]
    C --> D["编辑标题、描述、完成‘抛光’任务"]
    D --> E["使用‘刷新’功能提升曝光"]
    E --> F["持续每日上新保持流量稳定"]
    F --> G["提升成交机会，维持收益"]
```
